summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited consolidated net revenues for August 2026. The Taiwan-based semiconductor packaging and testing group reported monthly net revenues of NT$82,247 million (US$2,556 million), up 11.5% sequentially and 45.7% year over year; its ATM assembly, testing and material segment contributed NT$51,287 million (US$1,594 million), up 7.9% sequentially and 53.1% year over year. The disclosure satisfies Taiwan regulatory requirements; no transaction, board recommendation, advisor or deal terms are stated. It is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation.
